'''Allya's Redemption''' was a powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] sometimes used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] imparted an incredible [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] affect when used during combat, inflicting a straining amount of [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]]. The crystal was named after the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Allya/Legends|Allya]].

The Allya's Redemption crystal gave a lightsaber blade an elusive light green [[Color/Legends|color]] with a yellow core, resembling the special color crystal's venomous nature.

==Behind the scenes==
Allya's Redemption appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Allya's Redemption was added to the game with as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]]" on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
